Title: Users may be unable to connect to multiple Microsoft 365 services
Message:
User impact: Users may be unable to connect to multiple Microsoft 365 services.

More info: Features of the Microsoft 365 services below that interact with Exchange Online and email services are impacted.
- Exchange Online: Users may be unable to access their mailbox using Outlook on the web, Outlook desktop (MAPI), or Exchange ActiveSync (EAS), and email delivery may be delayed.
- Microsoft Teams: Scenarios that depend on Exchange Online, including calendar, are affected.

Current status: We’re identifying alternate workstreams to increase capacity.
Next update by: Saturday, November 1, 2026, at 4:30 AM UTC
